independent_technical_reasoning: The low address0x800 is meaningful only under the tool/platform injection address model and must be mapped before use. Corrected ODECC evidence requires UMC, ext0, HBMEccErr and corrected severity in the same attributable CPER; a new index alone is ambiguous. A corrected event should not produce uncorrected/fatal escalation or an unbounded counter storm. Since counters and logs are stateful, preserve baseline and do not retry automatically.
